title: MT69011: Powder Metallurgy Lab.I
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

1.Characterization of powders (Sieve analysis, apparent and tap density, flow
rate measurement, hydrogen loss test, SEM of powder and image analysis) â 2
labs2.XRD and BET surface area analysis of ultrafine/nano powders (crystallite
size, strain, surface area measurement and phase identification) â 2
labs3.Compaction of powders (density gradient as a function of height, weight
and compaction pressure) â 2 labs4.Conventional sintering of powder compacts â
1 lab5.Non conventional sintering technique (microwave sintering) â 1
lab6.Reaction synthesis of different ceramic powders and whiskers (Borides,
nitride, carbide, silicides, etc) â 2 labs
